title: LG promises to stop McAfee spam ads following pressure from Microsoft - Engadget
summary: It added that the "LG Monitor App Installer is distributed through Microsoft's official Windows distribution process, which included McAfee as an option." However, the company failed to explain why it installed its own ad-pushing app without user permission.
